title: On This Hill You Grow ROOTS Where You Belong
description:
On this hill, you grow roots where you belong. Old Mr Pell's run all the way to the gate, and when he visits his brother, they repot him. My boots have always come up clean.

Mum has the plot across the path, and her roots are the longest on the hill. This week she gave me her bucket. Then on Monday something came up by the gate, and every dawn it's one plot nearer to hers.

It's made up. A creepy blocky story, built with code and Blender.
pin: Where would your roots run to?
